excluded_content_classes: Internal agent instructions, execution plans, append-only ATG records, and runtime observations that can contain operator identity, deployment-local paths, subject identifiers, quality measures, or comparison scores.
Recorded real-result fixtures that contain derived biometric measurements or local actor attribution.
Runtime performance records that contain deployment-local storage paths and machine-specific observations.
included_metadata_boundary: Application source code, public protocol identifiers, registered artifact hashes, distributable aggregate assurance documents, release controls, and registry paths for the controlled deployment remain included; internal session records, source images, checkpoints, embeddings, operational databases, runtime observations, machine-specific performance records, and recorded result fixtures are excluded. The source archive is a controlled-host package, not a portable or generally redistributable bundle.
